activity_summary: The bill said the first part of Hercules, and it named no author. Alleyn came through a door in a lion's skin, taller than the door, and the voice filled the house. You were by the right-hand post.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the bill and stayed by the right-hand post.

entities.name: Edward Alleyn
entities.context: Came through the door in the lion's skin. He did not speak to the yard.

facets.activity: Stood by the post for Alleyn in a lion's skin
